description: A man with shoulder-length dark hair in a black clerical gown with white bands stands in the centre, one hand pressed to his chest and his face strained as he speaks. Around him crowd men in 18th-century waistcoats and cravats, some holding open books, and candles burn in a dim wood-panelled room with a door at the upper right. Dark oil-painting style, edge to edge, with no visible text.
